findings.claim: JPMorgan-based note (Oct 2025) puts Credo AEC share at ~80%, citing competition from Marvell, Broadcom and especially Astera; later secondary write-ups cite ~88% share. Neither is sourced to Dell'Oro/LightCounting; as_of is month-level approximate (2025-10).
findings.source: Investing.com, Credo Technology's SWOT analysis (search summary)

findings.claim: Marvell reportedly launched Alaska AEC products aimed at Credo's core market and runs a 'Golden Cable' AEC ecosystem initiative; Marvell expects AEC and retimer revenue to more than double YoY. Third-party analysis, primary source not verified; date not found.
Credo added a fifth hyperscaler customer (initial revenue) in fiscal Q2 2026; three hyperscalers each >10% of revenue, top three customers 39%/32%/17% of revenue in FQ3 2026.
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks, Will CRDO's Expanding Hyperscaler Base Accelerate Growth Momentum?

findings.claim: Settlements with Amphenol and Volex resolved AEC patent disputes via licenses (removes litigation overhang; implies licensed competitors in AEC).

competitive_share_entrants.note: No independent (Dell'Oro/LightCounting) share data found; as_of values are approximate month-level from search summaries (excerpts not verbatim available). No named competitor design-win against Credo found.
